Chasing overdue invoices is one of the most uncomfortable tasks on a founder's to-do list.

When done manually, it usually goes like this: you check your bank account on a Friday, notice an invoice from two weeks ago is unpaid, and spend twenty minutes drafting a polite follow-up email that feels awkward to send.

There is a simpler way.

A simple automated workflow can handle the entire cycle:
• Send a friendly reminder 3 days before the due date
• Send an automatic nudge the morning after it becomes overdue
• Update the deal status in your CRM the moment Stripe or your bank confirms payment

Automating the reminder depersonalizes the chase. It feels like standard accounting process rather than a personal confrontation, which means you get paid faster without damaging the relationship.
